literal_meaning: অনুকরণমূলক শব্দ যা ছোটখাটো ঝগড়া বা বকবকানির শব্দ নকল করে
figurative_meaning_en: petty quarrel; bickering; exchange of abuses
example_sentences_in_english: There's constant bickering in the household.
The two sisters are engaged in petty quarreling.
note: This idiom captures the everyday sounds of domestic disputes in Bengali households.
